description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 4 Bikes Included* Golf Cart- Optional $100/night* 2 Master Bedrooms* Balcony and Screened in Porch* Pet Friendly (dogs up to 20lbs) subject to approval and a $250 nonrefundable fee.* Infinity Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking Gulf and Topsail State Park * Beach Access at Dune Allen Beach - Short Drive Away* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Tennis courts, Nature Trails, and Fitness Center * Convenient Location: Close to dining and entertainment at Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place.* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions.* Welcome to your home away from home at Beach, Please, nestled in the tranquil Cypress Dunes. This spacious, pet-friendly, two-story retreat features 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and is just 1 mile from beach access. It overlooks a natural pond and lush trees, offering a peaceful setting for your stay. Three expansive porches, including one screened-in, provide ample outdoor living space, complemented by a fenced backyard perfect for children and pets to play. Large windows fill the open living area with natural light and frame serene views of the community.The family chef will delight in the well-equipped kitchen, ideal for whipping up delicious meals. Start your day with a cup of coffee on the porch, soaking in the view. Upstairs, two master suites feature king beds, while the guest room boasts two twin bunk beds. Each king bedroom includes an en suite bath, ensuring privacy and convenience for everyone.Take advantage of the community's outstanding amenities, such as a sparkling pool, tennis courts, and nature trails. Whether you seek a relaxing escape or an adventure-filled vacation, Beach, Please provides everything you need for the ultimate beach getaway, including the perfect accommodations for your furry friends.Along the west of 30A, just east of Miramar Beach, you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18-mile bike path that stretches to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity-edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area, or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!The Bed Setup: 2nd Floor:Master Bedroom 1: King Bed Master Bedroom 2: King Bed Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin/Twin Bunk BedsArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet out from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
